Microsoft.summary: FY27 reporting moves to Agents and Infra plus Devices and Consumer, reclassifies GitHub and Security Copilot into Microsoft 365 cloud, and leaves Q1 outlook including over $50 billion of capital expenditures unchanged. AI infrastructure and adoption remain supported; demand-quality and capital-efficiency cautions remain in force.

Nvidia.summary: Captured landing text matches the FY2027 Q2 earnings release: revenue $96.2bn and Data Center revenue $89.0bn, up 117% year over year. Infrastructure expansion remains supported. Supplier sales alone do not establish customers' AI ROI or independent demand.
Nvidia.limitation: Reviewer inspected the exact normalized text retained by Actions and corroborated the official earnings release. Direct local landing-page access returned HTTP 403.

Amazon.summary: Q2 2026 AWS sales grew 37% to $42.2bn. TTM operating cash flow was $161.4bn but free cash flow was negative $7.6bn amid AI-related property/equipment spending. Cloud expansion is supported; investment-related income is not independent AI demand.
Amazon.limitation: Captured landing text is navigation only. Financial conclusions use the linked SEC-hosted earnings release, not the landing-page fingerprint.

Apple.summary: FY2026 Q3 revenue was $109.4bn, up 16%; EPS included a $0.11 tariff-refund benefit. The release describes Siri AI introduction but does not isolate AI revenue or AI ROI. Adoption remains qualitative; total company growth is not attributed to AI.
Apple.limitation: Captured landing text is navigation only. Financial/product claims use the linked official newsroom release.

ai_infrastructure.reason: Six-company official evidence supports continued AI infrastructure expansion.

ai_capex.reason: Six-company official evidence supports continued AI capital-spending expansion.

ai_adoption.reason: Six-company official evidence supports continued enterprise and consumer AI adoption.

overall.reason: AI expansion remains intact, but demand quality and capital efficiency require monitoring.

independent_demand_quality.reason: Supplier-supported purchases and circular-financing exposure are down-weighted rather than counted as independent demand.

capital_efficiency.reason: Cash-flow conversion and AI monetization have not yet fully caught up with gross capital-spending growth.
